protocol.name: generalization_v1
protocol.surface: generic Spec v3 feature graph (atta.spec); shipped recipes are never called
protocol.held_out_rule: a case is held out when shape.family does not map to a shipped recipe (see excluded_families); shipped-family variants are <= 30% of the set and use parameter values no preset uses

constructible_ops.shell: difference of two revolves / an offset inner body
constructible_ops.chamfer: difference of rotated cutter prisms (see primitive.chamfer_box)
constructible_ops.fillet: difference of 'chamfer prism minus cylinder' cutters
constructible_ops.emboss: union of a raised body (text_emboss exists)
constructible_ops.engrave: difference of a text cutter (text_engrave exists)
constructible_ops.teeth: extrude of a sampled profile loop
constructible_ops.lipschitz: sdf() calibrates the field gradient to a metric distance

missing_ops.hull: Minkowski/hull of arbitrary solids is not in the op set

metrics.build_success: atta_model returned a model_id / cases attempted
metrics.faithful_build_success: built AND every reference op expressible AND declared topology matched
metrics.verify_pass: verify verdict == 'pass' / cases attempted (degraded counts as failure)
metrics.param_recovery: max relative bbox error vs the record's declared dimensions (null when the record declares no usable dimension)
metrics.op_coverage: (native + constructible) reference ops / total reference ops
metrics.op_coverage_native: native (first-class) reference ops / total reference ops
metrics.family_coverage: coverage-matrix categories that have a shipped family
metrics.reuse: per new family: corpus variants available vs the 5-variant target

protocol.verify_constraints: closed + n_components/genus from the record's tests[].expect + bbox windows from the record's declared parameter defaults (+/-2% or 0.5 mm)
honesty_notes: param_recovery is near-tautological: the graph is parameterised from the same declared numbers it is scored against, so it measures dimensional fidelity of the spec pipeline, not generalization.
build_success only means a model_id came back; faithful_build_success adds 'all reference ops expressible' and 'declared topology matched'.
degraded verify is counted as a failure.
